title: Reddit r/forhire — 1JGM Blueprint-to-Bot Systems Operator
copy:
[For Hire] Blueprint-to-Bot Systems Operator — AI Research, Automation, Technical Documentation, QA & Construction-Tech | US$20–35/hr

I’m Justice Gray Maciocha, an Alberta-based individual freelancer working as **1JGM — Blueprint-to-Bot Systems Operator**. I combine hands-on construction and field judgment with AI-assisted research, workflow architecture, automation planning, technical documentation, QA, and cross-domain problem solving.

I’m looking for remote, asynchronous, deliverable-based freelance work that I can complete evenings and weekends. I work best when the objective is clear, the output can be inspected, and quality matters more than being online all day.

**What I can help with**

• **AI research & synthesis:** product, market, competitor, technology, opportunity, supplier, grant, partnership, software, Web3, construction-tech, clean-tech, and digital-platform research; source verification; comparison matrices; evidence registers; executive summaries; uncertainty tracking.

• **Prompt engineering & AI workflow design:** structured prompts, reusable prompt systems, role decomposition, multi-agent workflows, output contracts, critique loops, human-review gates, context design, evaluation rubrics, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.

• **AI evaluation / QA:** compare model outputs for accuracy, completeness, relevance, structure, evidence quality, consistency, and failure modes; create defect taxonomies, correction queues, calibration examples, and repeatable QA processes.

• **Technical writing & documentation:** PRDs, requirements, specifications, SOPs, checklists, runbooks, README files, architecture notes, implementation plans, risk registers, evidence packages, decision logs, troubleshooting guides, onboarding material, research briefs, and plain-English technical explanations.

• **Automation & technical prototyping:** AI-assisted Python/JavaScript workflows, JSON/YAML, API/FastAPI/MCP concepts, GitHub workflows, CI diagnosis, schemas, logs, tests, browser-automation architecture, integration planning, process mapping, exception handling, and human-approval design. I position this accurately as AI-assisted prototyping/coordination rather than unsupported senior-engineer equivalence.

• **Data / spreadsheet / listing QA:** deduplication, normalization, categorization, structured data cleanup, URL and listing audits, missing-field detection, price/feature comparison, trackers, completion matrices, defect tracking, and structured reporting.

• **Project & operations coordination:** turn ambiguous objectives into workstreams, milestones, dependencies, blockers, acceptance criteria, handoffs, status reports, risk logs, issue triage, evidence requirements, and next-action plans.

• **Construction technology & field-to-digital work:** approximately eight years of construction/field experience including residential framing across 80+ homes, basement foundation formwork, junior HDD/utilities support, materials logistics, landscaping, maintenance, sequencing, measurement, staging, quality awareness, and practical troubleshooting. I can translate field processes into work instructions, checklists, training material, process maps, QA systems, and construction-tech workflows.

• **CAD / visualization / residential concepts:** foundational AutoCAD training plus independent SketchUp Web, Blender, AI visualization, floor-plan and residential concept work, and exploratory image-to-mesh/STL/3D fabrication workflows. I’ve created and iterated 300+ early-stage residential concepts. This is design/visualization support, not licensed architectural or professional-engineering work.

• **Trades / DIY technical content:** scripts, demonstrations, shot lists, B-roll plans, technical explainers, training content, product comparisons, and practical construction-oriented communication.

• **Creative / interdisciplinary work:** concept development, structured ideation, technical storytelling, presentation architecture, educational material, naming, scripts, and research-driven exploration.

**Working outside my existing scope**

I’m comfortable entering unfamiliar domains when the work can be approached responsibly. I do not pretend to instantly possess credentials I don’t have. Instead, I define the deliverable, build a terminology and source map, prioritize authoritative evidence, identify assumptions and unknowns, research deeply, test the result against edge cases and counterexamples, and escalate regulated or licensed conclusions to the appropriate qualified professional.

That means I’m open to unusual research, documentation, operations, AI, technical, construction, creative, and analytical projects even when I haven’t held the exact job title before.

**Evidence / examples**

• Designed governed AI workflows covering intake, specialist-role routing, evidence, approvals, QA, auditability, security boundaries, rollback, and verification.
• Produced PRDs, technical specifications, schemas, SOPs, checklists, test plans, threat models, risk/evidence registers, runbooks, decision records, and release-readiness reports.
• Directed AI-assisted code/API and repository work while separating local proof from production readiness.
• A portfolio prototype passed local Python compilation, 11/11 unit tests, 5/5 behavioural cases, tamper detection, artifact hashing, and local HTTP smoke tests.
• Construction background across 80+ homes plus 300+ early-stage residential concepts.

**Rates / engagement**

• US$20/hr — research, data cleanup, listing/URL QA, structured administrative work.
• US$25–35/hr — technical documentation, AI QA, workflow/automation specifications, project operations, construction-tech support.
• Fixed-price milestones are welcome.
• Small **paid** trial assignments are welcome when scope, acceptance criteria, deadline, and payment are clear.

I use AI as an accelerator where the client/platform permits it, but I personally review and take responsibility for delivered work. I won’t secretly use AI where a client prohibits it.

**Availability:** Alberta, Canada — Mountain Time. Remote/asynchronous evenings and weekends.

**Portfolio:** https://github.com/Lornt1666/RegenExcalibur/blob/main/FREELANCE_PROFILE.md

If you have a project, DM me with the problem, desired deliverable, deadline, approximate budget, and whether AI-assisted work is permitted.
